title: Reconciling Household and Payroll Employment: Latest Month
source: Bureau of Labor Statistics; author's calculations.
note: BLS's adjustment of the household survey to payroll-survey definitions; the items subtracted carry a reversed sign so the column adds down. Other nets the four items BLS does not seasonally adjust: unpaid family workers, private household workers and wage and salary workers on unpaid leave (subtracted) and multiple jobholders (added). It is BLS's seasonally adjusted payroll-concept total less the adjusted rows above it.
